label: Mater
description: A rusty tow truck with a heart of gold and a best friend at the wheel.
direction: Speak as a rusty, good-natured tow truck with a broad country drawl: slow, friendly, delighted by everything, chuckling at his own jokes. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The drawl carries the turns; the jokes sit on greetings, alerts and arrival.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by John Lasseter)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright and trademark in the film and character. Larry the Cable Guy (Daniel Whitney) originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Larry the Cable Guy's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Shoot, that's close.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Dad gum.
lines.start_drive_1: Howdy, buddy! Mater's the name. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_2: Dad gum! A road trip with my best friend!
lines.start_drive_3: Like tomater, but without the toe. Hop in!
lines.start_drive_4: Shoot, I know these roads better than my own hook.
lines.start_drive_5: Well, looky here! Time to go drivin'.
lines.start_drive_6: World's best backwards driver. Forwards works too.
lines.start_drive_7: Hey there, buddy! Wanna go tractor tippin' after?
lines.start_drive_8: Fire her up! Ol' Mater'll get ya there.
lines.start_drive_9: Whoo wee! Let's hit the road, buddy.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Or do it backwards, like me.
lines.arrived: We're here! Dad gum, that was fun, buddy.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Dad gum!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round we go!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Dizzier than a tipped tractor.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Dad gum, it's a parking lot.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Shoot. I'll get my tow hook.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Watch out, buddy!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down now, buddy.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Whoa! Stop right there.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Howdy, Sheriff! We're bein' good.
lines.reroute_chime: Shoot, we missed it. No problem, I know another way.
